title: Find the Smallest Number
description:
Same idea as the last problem, from the other side.

Given an array `nums` with at least one number, return the smallest number in it.

Example: for `nums = [6, 1, 4]` return `1`.
hints: Concept: this uses the same pattern as Find the Biggest Number. Look back at your solution there.
Approach: remember the smallest number seen so far, starting with the first one. Replace it whenever you find a smaller one.

workedExample.title: Length of the Longest Word
workedExample.description: Given an array of words, return the length of the longest one.
workedExample.explanation:
Different data (words instead of numbers), same **best so far** pattern: start with the first item, compare each item to the best, and update when you find a better one.

Once you spot this pattern, you can use it for biggest, smallest, longest, shortest, oldest…

walkthrough.note: 4 is not smaller than 1. Keep 1. Return 1.

mistakes.hint: `smallest` started at 0, and no positive number is smaller than 0. Start it at `nums[0]` instead.
You found the biggest number. To find the smallest, flip the comparison to `<`.
You skipped the last number. The loop should run while `i < nums.length`.
